permissions.view: Search, view and decode item codes
permissions.item.create: Create an item in an existing group
permissions.item.deactivate: Deactivate an item (also disabled in ERPNext once approved)
permissions.item.delete: Delete an item or a spec value
permissions.group.request: Request a new, renamed or edited group, or new spec values, for approval
permissions.group.edit: Create, rename or edit a group and add spec values directly
permissions.taxonomy.edit: Create, rename or delete heads and sub-heads
permissions.push.request: Send selected items, with tax template and HSN, for approval to push to ERPNext
permissions.approve: Approve or reject requests, singly or in bulk; approval pushes to ERPNext
permissions.erp.health: Run the ERPNext health check (read-only anomaly report)
permissions.admin: Admin dashboard, system toggles, settings and the dataset switch

roles.name: Associate
roles.description: Finds and creates item codes, edits and deactivates items, and sends group changes and ERPNext pushes for approval.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Everything an associate can do, plus delete items, change groups, heads and sub-heads directly, approve and push to ERPNext, back up and run the ERPNext health check.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Everything a manager can do, plus the admin dashboard, system toggles, settings and the dataset switch.
